title.narrative: Strengthening Brazilian Civil Society: Knowing and Acting in UN system

description.narrative: This project aims to strengthen the participation of civil society, training human rights defenders from all over Brazil. To this end, it seeks to increase knowledge about the UN's international human rights mechanisms, such as the Universal Periodic Review (UPR) and the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development (SDG). And also expand and strengthen networks of articulation and implementation of incidences that aim to improve the situation of human rights in the country.
